title: CLEAR: A Comprehensive Linguistic Evaluation of Argument Rewriting by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating the magnitude of linguistic and structural changes (the delta of the metrics between original and improved texts) with the length of the original input texts using Pearson's standard correlation coefficient.
Measuring the magnitude and direction of shifts in sentiment polarity between the original human-written text and the LLM-generated improved text.
